title: Hungarian Labour Market Yearbook 2009 (Fazekas–Lovász–Telegdy eds.)
title_hu: Munkaerőpiaci Tükör 2009 (Fazekas Károly, Lovász Anna, Telegdy Álmos szerk.)
summary_en: The 2009 Hungarian Labour Market Yearbook (Munkaerőpiaci Tükör), edited by Fazekas, Lovász and Telegdy, summarises the Hungarian labour market entering the 2008–9 crisis. Coverage includes labour-market microdata (employment, wages, unemployment by region and demographic group), institutional reviews (active labour-market programmes, unemployment benefits, minimum-wage setting), and a thematic In-Focus section on the early labour-market consequences of the global financial crisis.
policy_relevance: Reference volume for Hungarian labour-market policy retrospectives — the 2009 yearbook is the canonical baseline for measuring crisis impact and the effectiveness of the policy response (job-protection wage subsidies, unemployment-benefit reform, minimum-wage adjustment). Useful input for current contingency planning at NGM and BM Foglalkoztatáspolitikai Stratégia.
